terrain.elevationDatum: Metres above the 1,737,400 m lunar reference sphere; tied to LOLA. Radius/height conversion verified against the LROC NAC Processing Guide.

NASA Apollo16 Mission Report, section4 and8.1

gaps: The NASA traverse schematic is a planning-scale overview, not an orthorectified station survey. Use approximately 100 m uncertainty for its broad corridors; exact boulders need station planimetric maps.
ALSEP / stations 10 and 10-prime share a small near-base cluster. Their 30–50 m internal relationships are sourced from ALSJ but approximate here; the overview cannot locate each instrument.
Do not fill missing station numbers with invented visits. Completed distant stations are 1, 2, 4, 5, 6, 8, 9, 11 and 13, plus near-base 3/10 and 10-prime.
On-foot North Ray sampling extends beyond the rover parking point. Its 250 m station operating area is reserved, not a fabricated footpath.
Routes depict driven corridors; add bootprints only at documented walking work areas. No individual footprint placement is claimed.
Per-pixel DTM confidence, shadow/interpolation artifacts, real surface grades, and precise image-station registration remain construction prerequisites.
The source overview covers the mission region but cannot reconstruct every short movement within sampling sites. Operating disks reserve space without presenting invented paths.

distanceAudit.note: Trace length is a QA diagnostic, not a reconstructed odometer. Overview simplification and unregistered local manoeuvres can contribute to the discrepancy; exact accounting is unresolved. Do not stretch geometry to force agreement.

scaleRecommendation.status: Recommendation for prototype, not a runtime change or final pacing approval.

localOperations.status: areas reserved; detailed walked routes unregistered
localOperations.note: ALSEP, instrument deployment, final LRV parking and sampling walks are spatially within the construction envelope. Overview routes represent the long traverses; station operating radii are design allowances, not measured visited polygons.

coverageAudit.note: 17 preserves original GIS components; 15/16 retain reviewed overview polylines. Station operating areas are reserved design space, not measured walked polygons.
